patch: Sept 11 balance patch, Sept 17 fix and Sept 24 update (cosmetic only)
methodology: Tiers are curated estimates for each rank bracket, built from public win, pick and ban data after the latest balance patch. PC is the baseline.
Console tiers match PC except where official data shows a clear platform gap. Those heroes move one tier.
Each hero lists the best counter overall and the best counter in every role, so you can answer a threat without leaving your role.
Data-backed counters are supported by public matchup data. Kit-based counters come from how the heroes’ abilities interact. Consensus picks come from community play.
Bans happen at Gold III and above. Heroes marked as often banned may not be available.
Picking a map in the draft helper nudges close calls toward heroes whose play style suits its layout, mode and side. A real counter always outweighs the map.
The meta shifts with every patch. The data is reviewed weekly and after each balance update.
seasonNotes: Gorr the God Butcher (Duelist) is new this season.
Every Strategist now charges their ultimate more slowly.
Ranked bans at Gold III and above alternate 1-2-2-1, removing six heroes per match.
God Quarry, a new Domination map, is live in a limited Quick Match event through Sept 29. It is not yet confirmed for the ranked map pool.
changelog: Weekly review, Sep 26: no tier or counter changes. The Sept 24 update was cosmetic only (new God Quarry map in Quick Match, a Devil Dinosaur KO-feed fix); no ranked map pool change yet.
Draft helper: pick a map (and your side) to nudge suggestions by layout. Covers the 17 ranked maps.
Season 10 launch data: Gorr added, Sept 11 balance patch and Sept 17 Scarlet Witch fix reflected.

comps.name: Chaos brawl
comps.summary: Magneto and The Hood walk the team in while Scarlet Witch and Gorr melt anything close. Jubilee pairs with Scarlet Witch. The top comp in public comp models this season.
comps.evidence: Tops a public six-hero comp model. Part of its measured win rate comes from coordinated premade teams.

counter.name: Poke and peel
counter.why: Brawl has to walk in. Long-range damage from high ground punishes the approach, shields stall the push, and Magneto’s smaller shield breaks faster this season.

comps.name: Shield brawl
comps.summary: Doctor Strange’s shield anchors the same brawl core. The most-played lineup this season, though it wins on comfort more than on draft strength.

teamUps.name: Gamma Maelstrom
teamUps.note: If you run Hulk instead of The Hood.

comps.evidence: The most-played brawl in public comp data. A comp model rates the draft itself as weak.

counter.name: Anti-tank dive
counter.why: Wolverine is Doctor Strange’s hardest counter. Take out the shield holder and the brawl falls apart.

comps.name: Peni dive
comps.summary: Peni holds space with webs and mines while Magik or Gorr and a mobile diver pick off the backline. Built from this season’s highest-rated heroes, and it needs voice comms.
comps.evidence: Peni, Magik, Gorr, Mantis and Ultron are the five highest win-rate heroes on a major stat tracker.

counter.name: Anti-dive brawl
counter.why: The Thing punishes Spider-Man and Black Panther, Rocket and Jubilee are Peni’s hardest counters, and Punisher out-ranges her nest. Or ban Peni or Devil Dinosaur, which high ranks already do.

comps.name: Flyer poke
comps.summary: Storm and Hela deal damage from the air and long range while Ultron heals from above. Strongest on open maps at high ranks, and better on PC.

teamUps.name: Ragnarök
teamUps.note: New this season, if you swap Gorr in for Storm.

comps.evidence: Storm wins well above average but is rarely picked. Aim-heavy poke performs better on PC.

counter.name: Hitscan and vertical dive
counter.why: Black Widow’s hitscan punishes flyers (less reliable on controller), and Spider-Man swings up to reach Ultron and other airborne heroes.

comps.name: Triple-Strategist sustain
comps.summary: Three Strategists out-heal the enemy while two Vanguards hold the line. It ruled last season but is weaker now that every Strategist charges their ultimate more slowly.
comps.evidence: Dominant in Season 9. Not yet re-measured after this season’s ultimate-charge nerf.

counter.name: Burst dive with anti-heal
counter.why: Black Panther is the top counter to most Strategists, Blade’s anti-heal cuts through the healing, and Magik or Gorr burst targets before heals land.
